title: Houthis Claim to Have Downed Saudi Drone Over Yemen
detail: Houthi forces claimed to have shot down a Saudi drone over Yemeni territory, continuing an ongoing pattern of aerial engagements between Houthi air defenses and Saudi-coalition surveillance and combat drones operating over Yemen.

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Intercepts Houthi Ballistic Missile North of Riyadh
detail: The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile targeting an area north of Riyadh, underscoring the continued cross-border threat posed by Houthi long-range missile capabilities. The interception highlights sustained Houthi attempts to strike deep into Saudi Arabia despite coalition air campaigns against their missile infrastructure.

title: Houthi Missiles Strike Aden International Airport
detail: Houthi forces launched missile strikes on Aden International Airport, targeting the internationally recognized Yemeni government's key port city. The attack marks a significant escalation against Aden, the de facto capital of the internationally recognized government, striking critical civilian and military infrastructure in the south.

title: Turkey Announces Support for Saudi Arabia Against Houthis
detail: Turkey announced it will assist Saudi Arabia in its fight against the Houthis, marking a significant new regional alignment in the Yemen conflict. The move signals a major shift in Turkish foreign policy in the Arabian Peninsula, potentially strengthening the Saudi-led coalition with NATO's largest standing military force.

title: Russia Denies Request to Mediate Between Houthis and Saudi Arabia
detail: Russia denied receiving any request to mediate between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia, closing off a potential diplomatic channel for de-escalation in the Yemen conflict. The denial eliminates a possible avenue for ceasefire negotiations at a time when regional tensions are escalating following Turkey's announcement of military support for Riyadh.
